title: Rebellion puts off the Hajj once more. Now it is the Ṭāʾifa of Aragon that splits: a so-called County of Teruel rises against King Alfons and holds the inner country of the kingdom, from Teruel north toward Saraqusṭa, leaving him the north. Another minor rising

data.held: most of inner Aragon on Trent's map; Aragon keeps the north
data.hajj: postponed by rebellion; the next pilgrimage falls on 8–13 Dhū al-Ḥijja 787, about 10–15 January 1386 (tabular calendar)
data.realm: the lands of the Toledan revolt are all back within al-Andalus on the same map

source: Trent's account and map screenshot, 3 May 1385
